variants.headline: Looking back: grant programme passes over needy districts
variants.sub: Districts in need were passed over by a government grant programme.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A government grant programme had passed over districts that needed it.

A grant programme should be assessed against its allocation objective, not merely the fact that it exists. Passing over districts in need is a significant defect against that measure. Commercial readers should distinguish that known problem from a guessed budget, a presumed recipient or an allegation about a private transaction.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The stewardship of {target} requires examination against the districts passed over. This paper records the allocation problem without supplying an unreported intention, recipient or legal conclusion as its explanation.
